description: This file contains a Kivy application demonstrating shader effects with custom ShaderWidget, including shader code definitions, widget classes, and application logic.

classes.name: ShaderWidget
classes.description: Custom widget that renders a framebuffer with shader effects, allowing dynamic shader source updates and widget composition.

classes.name: RootWidget
classes.description: Main layout containing shader control button and shader display widget, manages shader switching.

classes.name: ShaderTreeApp
classes.description: Kivy application class that builds and runs the shader demonstration interface.

methods.name: update_glsl
methods.description: Updates shader uniform variables 'time' and 'resolution' each frame.

methods.name: on_fs
methods.description: Sets the fragment shader source code; raises exception if shader compilation fails.

methods.name: add_widget
methods.description: Adds a widget to the framebuffer's canvas instead of the main canvas.

methods.name: remove_widget
methods.description: Removes a widget from the framebuffer's canvas.

methods.name: on_size
methods.description: Adjusts framebuffer size and updates texture when widget size changes.

methods.name: on_pos
methods.description: Updates framebuffer rectangle position when widget position changes.

methods.name: on_texture
methods.description: Updates rectangle texture when framebuffer texture changes.

methods.name: change
methods.description: Cycles to the next shader in the list when button is pressed.
